verses.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
“How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
lines: “How long will you hunt for words?
Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.text: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
lines: Why are we counted as animals,
which have become unclean in your sight?

verses.text: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
lines: You who tear yourself in your anger,
will the earth be forsaken for you?
Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

verses.text: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
lines: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out.
The spark of his fire won’t shine.

verses.text: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
lines: The light will be dark in his tent.
His lamp above him will be put out.

verses.text: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
lines: The steps of his strength will be shortened.
His own counsel will cast him down.

verses.text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
lines: For he is cast into a net by his own feet,
and he wanders into its mesh.

verses.text: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
lines: A snare will take him by the heel.
A trap will catch him.

verses.text: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
lines: A noose is hidden for him in the ground,
a trap for him on the path.

verses.text: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.
lines: Terrors will make him afraid on every side,
and will chase him at his heels.

verses.text: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
lines: His strength will be famished.
Calamity will be ready at his side.

verses.text: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
lines: The members of his body will be devoured.
The firstborn of death will devour his members.

verses.text: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
lines: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent.
He will be brought to the king of terrors.

verses.text: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
lines: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his.
Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

verses.text: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
lines: His roots will be dried up beneath.
His branch will be cut off above.

verses.text: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.
lines: His memory will perish from the earth.
He will have no name in the street.

verses.text: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
lines: He will be driven from light into darkness,
and chased out of the world.

verses.text: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
lines: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people,
nor any remaining where he lived.

verses.text: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
lines: Those who come after will be astonished at his day,
as those who went before were frightened.

verses.text: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
lines: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous.
This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
